title: I made an Unreal co-op shooter for the Epic AI MegaJam and never opened Unreal.  I’d never even used Unreal before.
author: okuar
selftext:
I've never opened the Unreal Editor. Not even once.



I'm a Unity designer. For the Epic AI MegaJam, Claude Code wrote all the code, built the game, ran the tests and packaged it. It controlled Unreal through the official MCP server. My teammate did the 3D art.

All I did was play. I'd run the build, screenshot what looked wrong, and say "this part is boring."

At some point the game felt flat. So I didn't design more content. I asked the AI to do it. It built a director that watches the players and sets up scares: fake noises, lights going out behind you, attacks while you reload. It generates the levels too.

Three days later it's a real game: co-op for 1-4 players, Steam, voice chat.

If you want to try on itch (Windows): [https://izhard.itch.io/take-zero](https://izhard.itch.io/take-zero)





Happy to answer questions.

comments.author: Distinct_Pie_2300
comments.body: Hi op, question about this. How about assets? Do you still have to provide / get from marketplace?

replies.author: okuar
replies.body: mix of both. characters are ai-made (gemini concepts, tripo3D models), levels are our own. arms, animations, the gun and some VFX/sounds are free marketplace packs.
